manifest.name: dsh-account-alias
manifest.description: DSH 插件：左下角账户入口不再显示手机号前2后3位，改用自定义 id（可界面配置） | DSH plugin: use a custom id instead of the server-masked phone number in the sidebar account entry
manifest.author: PrismScopes

bundle.text:
# dsh-account-alias bundle patch
#
# 本包按组合包安装：profile 的 package.json 里加 `link:` 依赖，并把它列进
# `dsh.profile.bundles`；加载器把这一行合进 profile 的条目树。
#
# 行名必须**恰为包名**：`dsh-client-modules` 只把一个包的浏览器半边挂在说明符
# 恰为包名的那一行上，而这一行的配置页由 client.js 注册进 `plugins.row.config`
# （键 `dsh-account-alias#account-alias`）。
#
# config 是整行替换语义（不做深合并）。这里的取值只是**默认值**：设置页把改动
# 写进 profile 的 Cordis patch，覆盖的就是这一行的 config。
- insert:
    - id: account-alias
      name: 'dsh-account-alias'
      config:
        # 侧边栏账户入口与账号设置页显示的自定义 id；默认 User。
        # 留空 = 保留服务端昵称；支持 {uid} 占位符，展开成账号 UID。
        alias: User
        # keep = 仍然显示服务端脱敏后的手机号/邮箱；hide = 不显示（默认，隐私优先）。
        contact: hide
        # contact 为 hide 时用这段文字占位；留空 = 该字段直接不显示。
        contactText: ''

readme.text: [](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias)

**让 DeepSeek Harness 左下角账户入口不再显示你手机号的前 2 后 3 位，改用你自己设定的 id——并且可以在界面里随时改。**

装完重启一次，侧边栏那一行和「设置 → 账号」资料卡片里都不会再出现服务端下发的脱敏手机号/邮箱。

- 能力分类：界面与体验
- 许可证：MIT
- 平台：DeepSeek Harness（Desktop / Web 客户端），Windows / macOS 均可

> 上图是侧栏底部区域（3 倍放大）：原本会显示 `13*****678` 的位置，现在显示设定的自定义 id。
> 原始尺寸：[docs/account-entry.png](docs/account-entry.png)

---

侧边栏底部的账户入口由官方包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` 渲染，标签算法是：

```
profile.name ?? profile.contact ?? t("signedIn")
```

而 `contact` 并不是前端算出来的，是宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platform`
对 Platform 响应的投影：

```js
contact: mobile || mobile_number || email || null
```

也就是 **Platform 已经脱敏过**的手机号（形如 `13*****678`）或邮箱。前端只是原样显示，
所以没有设置昵称的账号，左下角必然出现手机号的前 2 后 3 位。同一个字段也出现在
「设置 → 账号」的资料卡片里。

本插件把显示换成你自定义的 id。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias
```

装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（宿主只在启动时读取 profile）。

也可以在「设置 → 插件市场」里搜索 `dsh-account-alias` 一键安装。

> Windows 上如果你是从本地源码目录安装（`link:` 方式），请用仓库里的
> `install.ps1`：它会做一次真实副本安装并做加载自检。原因见下方「为什么本地源码安装要额外一步」。

打开 **侧栏「插件」→ dsh-account-alias → 行 `account-alias` → 配置**，可以改三项：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 自定义 id | `User` | 左下角账户入口与账号设置页显示的内容。留空 = 保留服务端昵称；支持 `{uid}` 占位符，展开成账号 UID |
| 脱敏联系方式 | `不显示` | 服务端下发的就是已脱敏手机号或邮箱。选「不显示」后两处界面都不再出现它 |
| 占位文本 | 空 | 「不显示」时用这段文字顶上；留空则该字段直接不出现 |

保存后**即时生效，不需要重启**（配置字段以 volatile 形式下发）。

等价的配置文件写法（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: account-alias
  name: dsh-account-alias
  config:
    alias: PrismScope

这条链路上只有一个共享注入点：

```
Platform HTTP
  → dsh-deepseek-account-platform   实现 ctx.deepseekAccount
  → dsh-api-account-controller      getProfile() → ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile(client)
  → client ui-settings-account      settings.launcher 标签 + 设置页资料卡片

插件把宿主的 `ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile` 包一层，只改写返回值里的 `name` / `contact`：

- **没有替换任何 UI 席位**。账户菜单（设置入口、意见反馈、退出登录、头像、赠金通知）
  仍是官方原装组件，只是它读到的资料变了。
- **账号 UID（`id`）绝不改动**。平台用它隔离赠金通知（`identityOf`），
  `getPlatformSession` 也复用它，改掉会串号。
- 被替换的方法从**原型**上取，不从实例取：重装时永远包在真正的 provider 方法外，
  不会叠在上一个包装器上；插件卸载时删掉自己加的实例属性，原行为完整恢复。

- **不联网**。插件本身不发任何请求，只改宿主已经拿到的资料投影的显示值。
- **不读凭据**。不接触 token、不读 cookie、不写任何文件；`getProfile` 的原始响应
  仍由官方包获取，插件只在返回路径上改两个字符串。
- **不改服务端数据**。Platform 请求本身照旧，脱敏字段该传什么还传什么；
  推理鉴权、赠金通知的账号标识、意见反馈问卷的 `uid` prefill 都不受影响。
- **配置文件**：只读 profile 的 Cordis 配置（由宿主提供），设置页的写入由官方
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 落盘，插件不自己写文件。
- 唯一的外部依赖是宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（用于生成设置表单）。
  拿不到它时，插件仍然工作，只是设置表单消失并在日志里说明原因。

- **只改显示**。服务端下发的仍然是脱敏后的联系方式，本插件只控制它是否出现在界面上。
- 保存后，侧边栏那条标签要等一次账户资料刷新才会更新——重新打开一次设置面板即可。
- 依赖宿主存在 `ctx.deepseekAccount`（Desktop 登录态）。未登录时侧边栏显示的是
  「更多」行，本来就没有手机号。
- 兼容性：面向 DSH `0.2.x` 系列构建，使用 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` ≥ `3.18.4`。

readme.section: 为什么本地源码安装要额外一步
readme.text:
如果你用 `link:` 方式安装（源码目录 + 符号链接），插件里的 bare 导入
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 不会被解析到宿主副本，而是沿真实路径命中你机器上可能存在的
**旧版本**（3.18.2 没有 `Schema.prototype.volatile`），模块在求值期抛错、条目静默失效。

平台规则见 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `routeLinked()`：linked 包里的 bare 导入，
只有在该包 manifest 的 `peerDependencies` 里列出这个名字时才会被拦截到宿主副本。
本包已经声明了 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peer，并且 `install.ps1` 会把包复制成
**profile 层包**（真实目录），此时无论走拦截还是普通解析，命中的都是正确那份。
从插件市场（git）安装则天然是 profile 层包，不需要这一步。

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | 宿主半边：导出 `Config`（三个 volatile 字段）+ `apply`，包装 `getProfile` |
| `profile-alias.js` | 纯逻辑：配置归一化、volatile 现读、资料改写、补丁与还原（无外部依赖，便于单测） |
| `client.js` | 客户端半边：注册 `plugins.row.config` 的设置表单（手写 `__ModuleLoader__` 模块，无需打包） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁行与默认配置 |
| `install.ps1` | 可选：Windows 本地源码安装 / 卸载，自带加载自检 |
[MIT](LICENSE)
[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias)

**Stop DeepSeek Harness from showing the first two and last three digits of your phone number in the bottom-left account entry — show your own id instead, and change it from the UI whenever you like.**

After one restart, neither the sidebar entry nor the profile card in **Settings → Account** shows the server-provided masked phone number or email any more.

- Category: Interface & experience
- License: MIT
- Platform: DeepSeek Harness (desktop / web client), Windows and macOS

> The sidebar foot at 3x zoom: where a masked phone number such as `13*****678` used to appear,
> the configured custom id is shown instead.
> Native size: [docs/account-entry.png](docs/account-entry.png)

---

The account entry at the bottom of the sidebar is rendered by the official package
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account`, whose label expression is:

```
profile.name ?? profile.contact ?? t("signedIn")
```

`contact` is not computed by the client. It is the host-side projection performed by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platform`:

```js
contact: mobile || mobile_number || email || null
```

In other words, the **already server-masked** phone number (e.g. `13*****678`) or email.
The client only displays it verbatim, so any account without a nickname inevitably shows
the first two and last three digits of its phone number. The same field also appears on
the profile card in Settings → Account.

This plugin replaces what is displayed with your own id.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias
```

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness** (the host reads the profile only at startup).

You can also install it from **Settings → Plugin marketplace** by searching for
`dsh-account-alias`.

> On Windows, if you install from a local source directory (`link:`), use `install.ps1`
> from this repository: it installs a real copy and runs a load self-check. See
> "Why a local source install needs an extra step" below.
Open **sidebar "Plugins" → dsh-account-alias → row `account-alias` → Configure**:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Custom id | `User` | What the sidebar entry and the account settings card show. Empty keeps the server nickname. Supports the `{uid}` placeholder, expanded to the account UID |
| Masked contact | `Do not show` | The server sends an already-masked phone number or email; hiding it keeps both surfaces free of it |
| Placeholder text | empty | Shown in place of the hidden contact when not empty |

Saving takes effect **immediately, with no restart** (the fields are volatile).

The equivalent configuration in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: account-alias
  name: dsh-account-alias
  config:
    alias: PrismScope

readme.section: What it changes, and what it does not
readme.text:
There is exactly one shared injection point on this path:

```
Platform HTTP
  → dsh-deepseek-account-platform   provides ctx.deepseekAccount
  → dsh-api-account-controller      getProfile() → ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile(client)
  → client ui-settings-account      settings.launcher label + account settings card

The plugin wraps the host's `ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile` and rewrites only `name` /
`contact` in the returned value:

readme.section: What it changes, and what it does not
readme.text:
- **No UI slot is replaced.** The account menu (settings, feedback, sign out, avatar,
  bonus notice) remains the official component; it simply reads different data.
- **The account UID (`id`) is never touched.** The platform uses it to isolate bonus
  notices (`identityOf`) and `getPlatformSession` reuses it; changing it would cross
  accounts.
- The replaced method is captured from the **prototype**, never from the instance, so a
  reinstall always wraps the real provider method instead of stacking on a stale wrapper.
  On unload the own property it added is removed and the original behaviour returns.

- **No network.** The plugin issues no requests; it only rewrites the display value of a
  projection the host already obtained.
- **No credentials.** It never touches tokens or cookies and writes no files.
- **No server-side change.** Platform requests are unchanged; the masked field is still
  sent as before. Inference auth, the bonus-notice account id and the feedback form's
  `uid` prefill are unaffected.
- **Config**: the plugin reads its own Cordis config (provided by the host); writes from
  the settings form are persisted by the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`. The plugin
  does not write files itself.
- Its only external dependency is the host's own `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, used to build
  the settings form. If that cannot be resolved the plugin still works; only the settings
  form disappears, with the reason logged.

- **Display only.** The server still sends the masked contact; this plugin only controls
  whether it appears in the UI.
- After saving, the sidebar label updates on the next account-details read — reopen the
  settings panel once.
- Requires the host service `ctx.deepseekAccount` (desktop signed-in state). While signed
  out the sidebar shows a "More" row, which never had a phone number.
- Compatibility: built for the DSH `0.2.x` line, using `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` ≥ `3.18.4`.

readme.section: Why a local source install needs an extra step
readme.text:
With a `link:` install (source directory plus symlink), the plugin's bare import
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is not routed to the host copy; it resolves along the real path
and can hit an **older version** present on your machine (3.18.2 lacks
`Schema.prototype.volatile`), throwing during module evaluation and silently leaving the
entry inactive.

readme.section: Why a local source install needs an extra step
readme.text:
The platform rule lives in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`'s `routeLinked()`: a bare import
inside a linked package is intercepted to the host copy only when that package's manifest
lists the name in `peerDependencies`. This package declares the
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peer, and `install.ps1` copies the package into the profile as
a **profile-layer** package (a real directory), so either resolution path lands on the
right copy. A marketplace (git) install is a profile-layer package already and needs no
extra step.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: exports `Config` (three volatile fields) and `apply`, wraps `getProfile` |
| `profile-alias.js` | Pure logic: option normalisation, live volatile reads, profile rewriting, patch and restore (no external deps, so it is unit-testable) |
| `client.js` | Client half: registers the settings form into `plugins.row.config` (a hand-written `__ModuleLoader__` module, no bundler required) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch row and default configuration |
| `install.ps1` | Optional: Windows local source install / uninstall with a load self-check |
[MIT](LICENSE)
